details:
Q1. Which part of this repository should be improved?
Choices:
A. Clarify / plan / implement workflows
B. Review / autofix / conflict-resolution workflows
C. Orchestrator / validate / runtime-recovery workflows
D. Docs / workflow templates / repo ergonomics
E. A different specific area — name the workflow, script, or file path (RECOMMENDED)
Q2. What kind of improvement do you want most? (If multiple apply, answer like A+B.)
Choices:
A. Fix a specific bug, regression, or incorrect behavior (RECOMMENDED)
B. Improve reliability / reduce flakes / reduce stuck runs
C. Improve speed / cost / alert noise / efficiency
D. Improve docs / readability / maintainability
Q3. What should count as success?
Choices:
A. A specific failing example is fixed; I will provide a run ID, PR number, or issue number (RECOMMENDED)
B. A measurable workflow improvement; I will name the metric to improve
C. A visible docs or workflow-output change in a named file/path
Q4. How wide may the change be?
Choices:
A. Smallest targeted change in the named area (RECOMMENDED)
B. Small multi-file improvement within one workflow family
C. Broader repo-wide cleanup / refactor
